headline: The Battle Above the Clouds
post_facts: General Joseph Hooker led the Union attack
Fog hid the fighting on the mountain
Missionary Ridge followed the next day

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen sixty-three... Union soldiers fought a battle in the clouds.

scenes.label: Lookout Mountain, Tennessee
scenes.caption: Photo by Mathew Brady, 1864
scenes.title: High above Chattanooga
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] General Joseph Hooker's men climbed the steep slopes of Lookout Mountain, in Tennessee.

scenes.label: Storming Lookout Mountain
scenes.caption: Print, Library of Congress
scenes.title: Fighting inside the fog
scenes.text: [gravely] Thick fog rolled in, so even General Grant could barely follow the fight.

scenes.label: Lookout Mountain summit
scenes.caption: Civil War era photograph
scenes.title: A Union victory
scenes.text: [calmly] The Union took the mountain, and the next day stormed Missionary Ridge.

scenes.title: The Battle Above the Clouds
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] It became known as the Battle Above the Clouds.

scenes.title: Had you heard of this battle?
scenes.text: [gently] Had you heard of this battle?
